entities.summary: Lulu Sun is a New Zealand professional tennis player. She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 39 achieved on 9 September 2024 and a best doubles ranking of No. 190, reached on 24 February 2025. She is the current No. 1 Kiwi player in women's singles.
